part: ListSurfaceShell — PERF-12 virtualized remainder, row anatomy
artboards: 00-system-sheet (list-row anatomy, the same one every surface uses)
source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/DEVIATION-LOG.md, 2026-09-07 entry 'ListSurfaceShell.tsx (shared part, extended additively) — PERF-12 remainder virtualization restored': 'Row anatomy is unchanged either way — renderRow still returns one <ListRow/>, per PERF-12's own "virtualization only decides which rows mount" contract.'; src/components/list-surface/ListSurfaceShell.tsx (VIRTUALIZE_THRESHOLD=30) and src/components/ledger/VirtualizedRowList.tsx (real components, one band at 35 rows, expanded, so ListSurfaceShell mounts the real VirtualizedRowList path instead of the plain `.map()`)
notes: This is a STRUCTURAL claim check (does virtualization preserve row anatomy), not a page artboard's own stated pixel value — the artboard has no notion of virtualization at all (it shows static example rows). The comparison value is the shared listrow.json spec's own `.cl-list-row` geometry (min-height 56px, the class name itself), read from the SAME real ListRow.tsx component both the plain and virtualized paths render.

MEASURED, confirming DEVIATION-LOG's claim is TRUE, not asserted from reading the source alone: a standalone debug mount showed all 35 rows present immediately after mount (before `useNearestScrollParent`'s effect resolves), then windowing down to 27 of 35 once it does (no scrollable ancestor exists in this no-AppShell mount, so it falls back to `WindowVirtualized`) — the SAME `.cl-list-row` class and 56px min-height in both states. `run-audit.mjs`'s own 80ms post-mount measurement window lands AFTER that effect has already resolved (confirmed: this spec's own run reads count=27, not 35), so the windowed count is what this spec's row(s) are measured against; it is viewport/timing-dependent and no artboard states it, which is why COUNT is not asserted below (removed after a first attempt at `count:35` read a false MISMATCH here — a harness-timing artefact, not a design defect, fixed by dropping the count assertion rather than chasing a moving number, per this harness's own rule 4).

This spec adds NO new mount surface concept: it exercises the existing shared `ListSurfaceShell`/`VirtualizedRowList`/`ListRow` components exactly as RegulationsLedger.tsx already wires them (VIRTUALIZE_THRESHOLD, rowHeight=56, renderRow returning `<ListRow/>`) — reproduced from that file's own real integration, not invented.

children.name: a virtualized row keeps the real ListRow title cell (no page-local row shape)
children.note: Same class the shared listrow.json spec already checks (cell 3 — title): font-size 14px, weight 600. If virtualization forked its own row markup this selector would read NOT BUILT.

forbid.name: the literal word UNSCORED in a virtualized row
forbid.reason: General rule (operator 2.1), checked identically for the windowed path as the plain one.
